title: loam run send-review --json
description: The run after the send-review: Running, with the review of its PR sent to its session. With --dry-run, the run is as it was, and threads and reviews say what Loam would send.

pr.description: The PR as GitHub has it now, with its review threads and the reviews that request changes.

threads.description: The threads that are not resolved and have a comment by someone who can push to the repo.

reviews.description: The reviews that request changes and that Loam has not sent.
